residuals.observation: Four body lines have an approximately 11–12px actual glyph height at width720. Text can be deciphered but is too small for comfortable continuous mobile reading.
A tiny blue sign-like rectangle has pale indistinct strokes. They are not readable copy, but resemble background lettering.
The change of crop is largely absorbed by the glass frame; the explicit editorial seam is less apparent than the initial design described.

located_observations.observation: Two-line dark serif title is the first typographic anchor. Long pavement shadow and diagonal stone curb organize the lower and right image.
Both roles share the left start near31px; all four body starts are adjacent and sequential, but the smaller body weight and size create a sharp drop in comfortable reading.
Stone grains, worn joints, bevelled curb, aluminium frame and layered reflections remain distinct. Shadow extends from left off-frame over worn stone toward foreground.

layout.fidelity: soft wrap after first word; two remaining words kept together

revisit.resolution: At native scale the first syllable coda has two horizontal bars joined on the left and open on the right: ㄷ. It does not have a ㄹ middle zigzag.
revisit.reason: One revisit to resolve first-glyph class and initial incomplete native tool display

style.observations: Large substantive photographic scene, mature serif title, precise regular sans body, warm late light and subdued cool glass; explicit seam is subdued.

substantive_visual.observation: Worn joints, a passing person's shadow, a thin sunlit curb edge and reflected street activity express noticing urban traces.
